message: No runtime checks have run yet, so nothing has passed and the design isn't validated. All 8 blockers are the same issue: the generator doesn't yet have a native implementation for this Google Cloud pipeline (Collector, Pub/Sub, the DLP worker, BigQuery, the analysis service and Gemini). That's product engineering work, not a mistake in your design. The only Google Cloud contract it supports today is private object storage, and switching to it would cut this down to storage, so I'm not proposing a graph change. The fix is a typed GCP implementation for each block, with a reproducer: this revision-2 artifact (digest 93e4c7f8…) replaying a fixed synthetic set that includes a planted secret, a prompt-injection line, a missing span and a duplicate batch, all against a scripted mock model. Even when that passes, it will only prove the pipeline's controls work, not how good Gemini's answers are. That needs a real Vertex AI evaluation once the region and model access are approved. Meanwhile, let's finish the decisions this work depends on: which country does the incident telemetry need to stay in?
